tools.name: create_new_quire_project
tools.description: Create a new Quire project in the current directory or specified folder

projectName.description: The name of the new quire project

folder.description: The folder where the project should be created (defaults to the user's quire-projects directory)

starterTemplate.description: The starter template to use for the new project.

tools.name: build_quire_project
tools.description: Runs the Build command to generate html site files

projectName.description: Name of the quire project to build. Combined with projectPath treated as the parent folder. Projectname as they project directory.

projectPath.description: Path to the quire project directory or when combined with projectName, the parent directory containing the project.

tools.name: preview_quire_project
tools.description: Runs the Preview command to generate the html site files and start a local server. Typically port 8080.

projectName.description: The name of the quire projec to preview. Combined with projectPaht treated as the parent folder.

projectPath.description: The path to the quire project directory or when combined with projectName, the parent directory containing the project.

tools.name: stop_quire_preview
tools.description: Stops the currently running quire preview process, if any.
